sloka: भूताश्चार्था विनश्यन्ति देशकालविरोधिताः ।विक्लवं दूतमासाद्य तमः सूर्योदये यथा ।। ५.३०.३७।।।।
transliteration: bhūtāścārthā vinaśyanti deśakālavirodhitāḥ ।viklavaṁ dūtamāsādya tamaḥ sūryodaye yathā ।। 5.30.37।।।।

translations.english: "Even well planned diplomatic missions fail like darkness dispelled at Sunrise if the messenger is confused and if the place and time are not propitious for them.
